interpretation: The active species-by-active-site matrix expands in its number of rows and columns while average matrix fill remains within the prespecified practical-equivalence range. This supports approximately structure-preserving expansion of the observed acoustic incidence matrix within a +/-0.05 connectance-slope margin; it does not imply exact invariance.
boundary: Connectance is observed acoustic species-by-active-site matrix fill and equals alpha_active/gamma for the defined active matrix; it is not ecological interaction-network connectance.
